source_tables_checked.label: Table 1
source_tables_checked.caption: Amino acid sequence and physico-chemical parameters of both AamAP1 and its synthetic analogue A3.

source_tables_checked.label: Table 2
source_tables_checked.caption: Summary of the MIC and MBC values of A3 against all tested bacterial strains. Results represent triplicates.

source_tables_checked.label: Table 3
source_tables_checked.caption: Minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs) of antibiotics against the tested bacterial strains. MIC values are displayed in (µM) concentration. Results represent triplicates.

source_tables_checked.label: Table 4
source_tables_checked.caption: Synergistic activity of A3 in combination with conventional different strains of standard and MDR bacteria. Results represent triplicates.

source_tables_checked.label: Table 5
source_tables_checked.caption: List of all the A3-antibiotic combinations and their FIC indices. Results represent triplicates.

source_tables_checked.label: Table 6
source_tables_checked.caption: MBEC values of A3 and AamAP1 against biofilm-forming bacterial strain of S. aureus. MBEC values are displayed in (µM) concentration. Results represent triplicates.

source_tables_checked.label: Table 7
source_tables_checked.caption: Percentage reduction of viable bacterial cells of S. aureus biofilms including the minimum biofilm bactericidal concentration (MBCb) for A3 against tested bacterial strains.

source_tables_checked.label: Table 8
source_tables_checked.caption: IC50 values for A3 on HEK and Vero mammalian cell lines. Results represent triplicates.

source_tables_checked.label: Table 9
source_tables_checked.caption: Hemolytic effect A3 on human erythrocytes after 60 min of incubation. Results represent triplicates.
